opening: This copy is different. It's not about missions: it's about him. About when he was a boy.
silva: Raoul Silva is coming, a former MI6 agent. He feels betrayed by M and he's bringing an army.
houseLabel: Stone house in the Highlands, at night and in the mist
trapsHint: Tap 2 windows or doors, like Bond and Kincade.
trapsLegend: Windows and doors of the house
galleryLabel: Attacker silhouettes in the mist. Tap a silhouette to shoot.
fail: Fall back. This house isn't giving up yet. Try again.
silence: No music here. Only fire and wind.
burningLabel: The stone house burns in the night
transitionLabel: An ember rises and becomes the Caribbean sun
db5Label: Call the DB5: one burst clears the attackers in sight. One use.
